entities.name: Ralph Ambrose O'Neill
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ralph Ambrose O'Neill was a Mexican flying ace from World War I credited with 103 combat patrols and five aerial victories. He was the first "Chief" Commander of the modern Mexican Air Force. He was also a pioneer of commercial aviation.
